versions.changelog:
- Added a privacy warning advising not to print the CLI config file since it may store API tokens.
- Updated troubleshooting advice to avoid displaying sensitive auth config details; recommend re-authentication or sharing only non-sensitive outputs.
- Minor streamlining of instructions and removal of references to explicit config file paths in quick check steps.

Initial release of rssaurus-cli skill.

- Provides guidance on using the rssaurus CLI tool to interact with RSSaurus from the terminal.
- Includes troubleshooting steps for binary presence, configuration, and authentication.
- Documents commands for listing feeds/items, marking items read/unread, saving/unsaving items, and opening URLs.
- Explains how to use machine-friendly outputs and manage bulk actions.
- Shares reference links for further CLI help and authentication token generation.
